Subject: Questions on compliance add-on pricing and credits

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team found the residency + audit log options promising. Procurement has a few clarifying questions before we can progress to legal:

- Can you provide a clear line-item breakdown of the compliance add-ons (audit log tiers, KMS vs HSM pricing, per-seat HSM, and data residency cost)?
- Do you offer an implementation/onboarding credit we can apply toward the first invoice or SOW? If so, how is that typically structured (one-time credit vs spread over invoices)?
- For EU residency we need a committed node estimate and associated minimum term — can you share ballpark monthly committed cost so we can model TCO?

We'd like to get a one-page commercial summary to attach to our internal purchase request. We're aiming to have a go/no-go decision from finance by 11/24.

Thanks,

Hi Sanjay — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful. Attached is a concise commercial summary and a price table (see Compliance_Price_Table.xlsx). Key points up front:

- Audit logs: three retention tiers (30/365/730 days). 30-day = $0.01/GB/month, 365-day = $0.03/GB/month, 730-day = $0.045/GB/month. We can do the first 6 months of 365-day retention at no charge for onboarding (see credit below).
- KMS vs HSM: KMS (managed keys) is included; dedicated HSM seats are charged $5,000/seat/month list. We typically offer a first-year discount on seats for pilots.
- Data residency (EU): Dedicated residency nodes require a committed capacity (GPU-pool) — ballpark €18k/month for a small reserved pool; exact sizing depends on peak concurrency.

Implementation credit proposal (initial): one-time credit of $75,000 applied to the first invoice (or spread over first two invoices on request) — this covers SOW onboarding, migration support, and the 6-month complimentary retention for audit logs. Credit is contingent on a 12-month minimum committed agreement for the dedicated components.

I've looped in Marcus to confirm discount authority and Marissa for legal/finance notes. Can we book a 30-minute call next week to align on the SOW and DocuSign flow?

Best,
Irene

Irene — quick thoughts from pricing: we have headroom to be creative but want to protect recurring revenue. Proposals:

1) Split the $75k implementation credit: $45k applied to one-time SOW/onboarding fees, $30k as a bill credit against first three monthly invoices (helps their cash flow ask).
2) Offer 20% discount on HSM seats for year one (then revert to list unless they commit longer).
3) For EU residency, push for a 12-month committed pool; if they commit to 18 months we can extend the HSM discount into year two.

If legal flags anything, Marissa can advise on whether credits should be non-refundable and non-transferable. I also recommend we require a single PO plus DocuSign signature before applying credits.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Questions on compliance add-on pricing and credits — legal/finance notes

Flagging a couple commercial/legal constraints:

- We need the credit language to be explicit in the SOW: amount, how it's applied (invoice line item or credit memos), expiration date (90 days from signature), and clawback if customer terminates early.
- HSM seats: confirm whether third-party HSM provider pass-through fees are included. If not, itemize them as pass-through; we cannot absorb third-party support costs by default.
- Audit log retention complimentary period: limit to onboarding customers (first contract only) and specify capped GBs included (e.g., up to 10TB free during onboarding). Overages billed per price table.

I've redlined the terms addendum and attached it (Redwood_Terms_Addendum_redlined.docx). Also attached the updated SOW (CometHealth_Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf) with the credit line inserted as a single sentence and a PO/signature block.

If product needs to commit to any SLA credits for residency latency, please note that will increase risk and may require an SLA deposit. Marcus — confirm trade-offs if they push on guaranteed p50/p95 latency.

—Marissa
Director, Finance & Legal Operations | Redwood Inference

Sanjay — thanks for the patience while we aligned internally. Below is the commercial proposal we can commit to if CometHealth signs the attached SOW and the terms addendum:

1) Implementation credit: $75,000 one-time credit applied as follows — $45,000 against the SOW onboarding fees; $30,000 issued as a credit over the first three monthly invoices. Credit expires 90 days after signature.
2) Audit log retention: first 6 months of 365-day retention included at no charge, capped at 10 TB total during onboarding. Overages billed per the attached Compliance_Price_Table.xlsx.
3) HSM seats: 20% discount on the $5,000/seat/month list for year 1 (applies to seats billed on dedicated HSM offering). Third-party HSM provider pass-through fees are not included and will be billed separately.
4) EU data residency: available via a dedicated reserved pool; estimated starter commit ~€18,000/month. 12-month minimum to qualify for the implementation credit and HSM discount. 18-month term unlocks extended discounts per Marcus's note.
